text:
anya: FYI — nightly eval alert: instruction-follow promptset showing a sharp decline on the new quantized-v2 artifact. ML-EVAL flagged it as a quality regression.
ml-eval-bot: nightly-eval | model=quantized-v2 | promptset=instr-follow | metric=F1 | baseline=0.78 | current=0.686 | delta=-0.094 | fails=87 | CI: https://ci.internal/evals/2267890123 | snapshot: s3://evals/nightly/2267890123.json
alex: ugh. 9.4% absolute F1 drop is large. Any quick repro or diffs between float/v2 and quantized-v2?
jonathan: initial blind guess: quantization can change tokenization alignment if export pipeline munges pre-tokenization normalizer. saw similar once when nbsp was stripped.
maria: I ran a local eval with the same promptset against both artifacts. Short repro below:
```
# prompt snippet
> "Summarize the following policy in plain language:   The policy states..."
# float-v2 output
- good summary, concise.

# quantized-v2 output
- adds irrelevant hallucinated clause about "policy requiring opt-in" (not present).
```
maria: Also logged tokenization lengths: float-v2 -> 45 tokens; quantized-v2 -> 43 tokens for same input. That mismatch is suspicious.
ml-ci-bot: build-info | quantized-v2 | commit=9f3b2d4 | artifact=quantized-v2-2026-03-19 | export-pipeline=latest | pretokenizer=normalize_whitespace.py@main
anya: ok — plausible root cause: whitespace normalizer change in export pipeline removed non-breaking spaces and collapsed sequences, shifting token boundaries. That would break KV cache alignment and some role tokens for instruction prompts.
alex: can we validate by running tokenizer on failing samples across both artifacts and diff the token ids? I can do that now.
jonathan: if it's tokenization drift during export, mitigation plan: 1) immediately pin prod models to float-v2 (rollback), 2) add gating check to onboarding harness that compares tokenization hashes + token counts vs canonical float artifact, 3) create a canary release for quantized-v2 at 2% with enhanced telemetry (tokenization diff alert), 4) add unit tests for normalize_whitespace.py in pipeline, 5) patch and re-export.
product-qa: plea from QA: any rollback will affect performance numbers; coordinate messaging if we revert hosted endpoints.
maria: I already ran token diff on the 87 failing prompts: 62/87 show token id shifts caused by replaced   -> regular space and collapsed double-space. sample diff (ids):
```
# float ids: [101, 234, 345, 456, 789]
# quant ids : [101, 234, 999, 456, 789]  # 345 -> 999 mismatch at pos 3
```
anya: good repro. action items:
- anya: open incident ticket and coordinate rollback with infra (ETA 30m).
- alex: implement gating check in onboarding harness to fail if token_count_delta > 0 or token_hash != baseline (ETA 2d).
- jonathan: add unit tests + patch normalize_whitespace.py to preserve NBSP and avoid collapsing intentional spacing (ETA 1d).
- maria: run expanded eval (full nightly) on patched export locally and paste results (ETA 12h).
- product-qa: prepare customer comms template in case regression affected customers (ETA 4h).
ml-ci-bot: started rollback job to pin hosted endpoints to float-v2 baseline. job-id=rb-2267890150 | status=started
alex: for the gating rule, proposal: compare tokenization sequence for 500 random samples; if >1% mismatch, fail onboarding. We'll add a small `tokenization-check` step in the CI. Example check command: `python -m eval_tools.token_check --baseline S3://models/float-v2/tokens --candidate ./artifact/tokens --threshold 0.01`
jonathan: note: also add a regression monitor to alert if eval metric delta > 3% in any release canary window (1h).
anya: good. Can we get a short postmortem template saved under eng-ml/postmortems after immediate actions? We'll collect logs and schedule a deep-dive tomorrow.
product-qa: thanks. keep me updated on rollback completion.
ml-ci-bot: rollback job rb-2267890150 | status=success | completed_at=2267890310
anya: rollback done. hosted endpoints pinned to float-v2. Next: follow the mitigation plan and gate re-onboard of quantized-v2 until tokenization invariant is fixed + passing canary.
alex: I'll own the gating PR and CI changes. assigning to myself.
jonathan: I'll push the normalize_whitespace patch and include property tests for NBSP handling.
maria: will run full nightly locally and post the new eval snapshot here when done.
anya: thanks all. keeping this thread as the coordination log. we'll convert to a public postmortem if needed after root cause verification. :white_check_mark:
